option point, was completely nominal.

started and stopped on time, and residuals were negligible.

change in the simulator.

during the midcourse correction maneuver,

and docking, interfered with normal operational functions to a degree not seen in training.

pilot was forced to spend full time adjusting, pointing, and narrating
the television broadcast.

during

television
